First release of the native Honda Sim: one Windows program, `HondaSim.exe`, with no installer and nothing else to download. Run it and it starts.

**What's in it**
- K20Z3 (2006–2011 Civic Si) engine, drivetrain and internals model, driven by a wheel and pedals (any controller Windows sees) or the keyboard.
- 3D engine view in the centre, dash along the top, sim panels on the left.
- Tables tab: enter or paste FlashPro tables (fuel, ignition, cam angle for low and high cam, boost target, wastegate duty) and the switch points. Save named tunes.
- Parts: aftermarket cranks, stroker kits, rods and pistons with real fitment rules; materials per part; part loads, fatigue and failures.
- Turbo and supercharger setups.
- Cooling and oil: coolant circuit, thermostat, radiator, fans, oil temperature, viscosity and pressure, the factory oil cooler, oil to each main and rod bearing, piston squirters, and turbo oil and coolant lines. Temperatures feed friction, knock, VTEC, bearing film and piston temperature. Try **Cold start** on the Cooling tab.

**Controls**: R start, W/S throttle and brake, C clutch, E/Q shift, 1–6 gears, N neutral. Map the wheel and pedals on the Wheel tab.

**Notes**
- Built for 64-bit Windows. Not yet tested on a real Windows machine or with a real wheel; please report anything that doesn't work.
- Windows SmartScreen may warn because the program isn't signed: choose More info, then Run anyway.
- Settings, tunes and logs are saved in `%APPDATA%\HondaSim`.
- The included tune is a placeholder, not a real calibration. On turbo setups the stock pistons will fail quickly; fit forged pistons and rods first.
